name: Grunt Dogran
summary: Grunt Dogran waits in captivity deep in the southern Barrens. Once assigned to the Crossroads and then Camp Taurajo, he was taken during a patrol into Agama'gor.

sections.title: A Grunt's Duty
sections.body: Grunt Dogran was sent from the Crossroads to reinforce Camp Taurajo after rising in the Horde military. He led a detachment of grunts into Agama'gor, where they met the Bristleback quilboar in a fierce clash. Dogran was badly wounded and crippled. His comrades retreated without him, and the quilboar dragged him into captivity.

sections.title: An Honorable Fate
sections.body: Grunt Dogran remains trapped behind enemy lines, crippled by his wounds. He refuses to return home broken and make his mate care for an invalid. Instead, he asks for a final stand against the quilboar and for a token of his devotion to reach the one he loves.

faq.answer: Dogran is held captive at Agama'gor, a dense quilboar encampment in the southern Barrens, just north of Camp Taurajo.

faq.q: Why was Dogran captured by the quilboar?
faq.answer: Dogran was captured after he led a patrol from Camp Taurajo to strike at the quilboar and suffered crippling injuries in the clash. His comrades could not carry him away in time, leaving him in their hands.

faq.q: Why does Dogran refuse to be rescued?
faq.answer: Dogran was permanently crippled in battle and refuses to return home as a burden to his mate. He would rather die fighting the quilboar than live as an invalid.

His mate Zankaja in Orgrimmar is looking for him after hearing nothing since he left for duty. Her worry leads travelers to Gazrog at the Crossroads, then to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo, where soldiers piece together what happened to the missing patrol.

angles.text: As an orc, Dogran reflects the belief that dying in battle brings more honor than surviving as a helpless invalid.
Dogran's capture shows the cost the Horde garrisons pay to secure trade roads and borders across the Barrens against aggressive quilboar tribes.
